steps.content: Screams and fear spread all the way to the edge of the town. Vautour Bleu turns back, looking at the town she's been striving to sustain, which is now falling apart before her eyes.
She recalls the first time she passed by this place with her caravan: nothing more than a ruin in the sands, yet its soil was so unusually suited for datura flowers.

For the struggling Outlands in WhiteSands, there are never enough Mania-inhibiting Hypercubes to save those with dangerously high M-values. Each stop the caravan made brought new faces, new refugees seeking shelter from Mania's grip.
Vautour Bleu's little neighbor guesses right. Désir's disastrous Mania contamination isn't just because of the monsters—it's because every single resident here is on the brink of mutation.
She's tried, time and again, to save everyone she met. But it never lasted long. The sandstorms and despair would engulf everything each time before she could find the key to sustaining hope.
After all this time searching WhiteSands, she finally found this place and named it Désir, praying it would bring a new beginning.

But her hopes had limits. The datura flowers could only prolong their dreams, not realize them. "Maybe we should just go and rob some Hypercubes," she'd sometimes joke with her crew, but deep down she knew it would only invite greater disaster.
Vautour Bleu takes a long drag from her pipe, feeling the town's decay creeping beneath her feet. She begins counting down in her mind...

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I know the town won't hold out for long and the truth will be known. So, before Désir bursts from despair like a balloon... let's pop it ourselves.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: The dreams shall end. Time to wake up.
